content.text: This document is published in several languages for your convenience. In the event of any discrepancy between versions, the Spanish version shall prevail.

Tikky is a personal finance management tool: it digitizes receipts using artificial intelligence, organizes expenses and income, manages budgets and subscriptions, and generates reports and answers about your own data.
